content: The customer, Aditya Singh, called the insurance agent, Vikram Patel, to confirm the receipt of his INR 2,300 payment for the flood-damage rider. The agent confirmed the payment and that policy HC-AD-2026-001 is now active with the rider. Additionally, the customer requested an address update on the policy document, which the agent completed and re-emailed to the customer during the call.
